## Perda Kota Surabaya Nomor 8 Tahun 2018
Answer: Perda Kota Surabaya Nomor 8 Tahun 2018 menetapkan Rencana Detail Tata Ruang (RDTR) dan Peraturan Zonasi untuk seluruh wilayah Kota Surabaya dengan cakupan waktu perencanaan tahun 2018 hingga 2038. RDTR berfungsi sebagai acuan operasional dalam pemanfaatan ruang dan penerbitan izin, serta sebagai alat pengendali pembangunan fisik di kota. Perda ini mencakup pengaturan struktur ruang, pola ruang, ketentuan zonasi, klasifikasi kawasan (lindung dan budidaya), ketentuan intensitas bangunan, garis sempadan, zona. Perda ini ditetapkan pada 17 Desember 2018 dan diundangkan pada 27 Desember 2018.

Answer: PP Nomor 21 Tahun 2021, officially titled "Peraturan Pemerintah Nomor 21 Tahun 2021 Tentang Penyelenggaraan Penataan Ruang," was established on February 2, 2021, in Jakarta by the President of Indonesia, Joko Widodo. It pertains to the regulation of spatial planning, including the management of land use, the control of land utilization, and the supervision of spatial planning. The regulation also includes the establishment of institutions for spatial planning. The document has been viewed and downloaded several thousand times, indicating its significance and accessibility.

## UU Nomor 26 Tahun 2007
Answer: UU Nomor 26 Tahun 2007 tentang Penataan Ruang was enacted in Jakarta on April 26, 2007, and it replaced UU Nomor 24 Tahun 1992. The law aims to improve the management of national spatial planning to ensure sustainability and well-being. It includes provisions on administrative and criminal sanctions for enforcement and a transition period of three years for adapting land use to new spatial planning. The law is in effect and has been amended by UU Nomor 11 Tahun 2020 tentang Cipta Kerja.

Answer: Perda Kota Surabaya Nomor 12 Tahun 2014 is a regional regulation concerning the spatial planning of Surabaya City for the years 2014-2034. It was established on August 22, 2014, and its scope includes the framework, vision, mission, objectives, policies, and strategies for spatial planning, structural and spatial plans, strategic area determinations, land use directions, land use control conditions, supervision, rights, obligations, community roles, and institutional arrangements, as well as administrative sanctions and legal provisions.
